selection_basis: Wave 4 closes the remaining transport/transfer gap while opening two zero-coverage required targets. Authoring stopped at 44 after removing five B14 acid/base candidates that were outside the adopted B14 oxidation/reduction plan scope; no quota backfill was performed.
authoring_rule: All 44 candidates were persisted as AI_PRE_ACCEPT before independent review. Review itself does not create Permanent IDs, canonical rows, source-verification rows, released rows or runtime rows.
collision_rule: Independent review rechecked all 44 candidates against all 205 canonical/source-verified questions and the full Wave 4 peer set. Nine low-value, source-navigation, or duplicate-reasoning candidates were rejected without quota backfill.
multi_source_rule: Each candidate binds to one registered source_id/version and one reproducible locator. Cross-source answer-defining comparisons are prohibited.
anti_duplication_rule: B15 does not recreate exact flash-point recall already represented in Wave 1; one same-SDS flash/autoignition comparison is retained and its substance-swapped duplicate is rejected.
